instruction: Make the title text 'Minimalistic Newsletter' bold on slide 1.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making the title 'Minimalistic Newsletter' bold on slide 1 (index 0). The evaluator checks if the text has bold formatting applied. Verified by inspecting PPTX structure - slide 1 has shape with text 'Minimalistic Newsletter'.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Getter function has incomplete text verification logic (slides.py:43-49). It returns immediately after checking the FIRST run containing the text, ignoring other runs.
If 'Minimalistic Newsletter' spans multiple runs with different formatting (e.g., 'Minimalistic' bold, ' Newsletter' not bold), the getter will only check the first run and incorrectly return True.
The task requires the ENTIRE title text to be bold, but the current logic may pass even if only part of the text is bold.
This is a semantic/logical flaw that will cause false positives at runtime - the evaluator cannot reliably verify that the complete title text is bold.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify getter to check ALL runs that contain parts of 'Minimalistic Newsletter', not just the first one
Accumulate bold status across all runs and return True only if ALL portions of the text are bold
Alternative: Check if the entire shape's text_frame has consistent bold formatting applied to all runs containing the target text
Add explicit handling for multi-run text scenarios common in PowerPoint when formatting is applied incrementally
